historical_material_observation.observation: The earlier retained Godot proof-host render was predominantly light gray/white rather than the authored darker weathered-steel/cool/warm palette.

bounded_repair.scope: Enable vertex_color_use_as_albedo only on materials attached to surfaces containing COLOR_0.

positive_profession_evidence: The profession traced a visual failure from retained runtime observation through source encoding into target-host material interpretation.
It established that the authored palette existed in COLOR_0 instead of rewriting art assets to compensate for a host-side interpretation defect.
It used a narrow adapter that preserved texture-binding counts and changed only the missing COLOR_0 albedo multiplication flag.
It promoted only the palette/tint sub-gate while keeping full material fidelity open.
remaining_for_maturity: full material-surface evidence including glass, normals, metallic/roughness and intended emissive behavior
additional targets/runtimes and failure families without stale acceptance transfer
truth_boundary: This continuation strengthens evidence for runtime visual diagnosis and bounded repair. It does not establish complete material fidelity, production-art quality, broad 3D game-asset competence, cross-executor reliability, final Wreckline readiness, or any profession maturity promotion.
